passive.name: Iron Ambassador
passive.description: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

spells.name: Hammer Shock
spells.description: Poppy smashes the ground, dealing plus % max Health physical damage and making the ground unstable. The unstable area Slows enemies by % and erupts after second, dealing plus % max Health physical damage again.
spells.coverageNote: An explicit live-patch duel module resolves this champion-specific damage packet.

spells.name: Steadfast Presence
spells.description: Passive: Poppy gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus is doubled if Poppy is below % Health. Active: Poppy gains % Move Speed and projects a field around her for seconds that stops enemy dashes. Enemies who are stopped by the field are Grounded and Slowed by % for seconds and take magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation InterruptDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Heroic Charge
spells.description: Poppy tackles an enemy, dealing physical damage and carrying them forward. If Poppy tackles them into terrain, the enemy is Stunned for seconds and take an additional physical damage.
spells.coverageNote: An explicit live-patch duel module resolves this champion-specific damage packet.

spells.name: Keeper's Verdict
spells.description: Begin Casting: Poppy begins charging her hammer for up to seconds, Slowing herself by %. Release: Poppy smashes the ground, creating a shockwave that deals physical damage to the first champion hit and surrounding enemies, Knocks them Back towards their Nexus, and makes them Untargetable while they fly. The range and Knock Back distance increase with charge duration. An uncharged swing deals physical damage and Knocks Up for seconds.
